NONE: › a condition in which someone experiences things through their senses in an unusual way, for example by experiencing a colour as a sound, or a number as a position in space
複合感覺，共同感覺

example: A person with synaesthesia may see, for example, the number 2 as a green number and the number 5 as a red number.
有複合感覺的人可能會把2看成是一個綠色號碼，5是一個紅色號碼。

NONE: › a building in which Jewish people worship and study their religion
猶太教堂，猶太會堂
› the point at which electrical signals move from one nerve cell to another
（神經元的）突觸
› the joining of chromosomes from each parent during the first stage of cell division
（染色體的）聯會，接合，對合

synchronization (synchronize)
› informal for
synchronize
› to connect two electronic devices so that they both have the latest information or files
（兩台電子設備之間）同步（更新最新的資訊和文檔）
› If two things are in/out of sync, they reach the same or related stage at the same time/at different times.
同步／不同步的

example: How do I sync my iPhone to my computer?
我該怎麼讓我的iPhone和電腦同步？

NONE: › a place in the body where two bones are directly joined together by cartilage (= strong tissue). In some joints the cartilage may turn into bone over time
軟骨結合
› relating to something, especially a language, at a particular point in time, without considering how it developed to that point
（尤指語言）共時的
› the happening by chance of two or more related or similar events at the same time
（兩件或多件相關或相似事情的）同時發生，同步性

I or T: › [ I or T ] to (cause to) happen at the same time
T: › [ T ] When people synchronize their watches, they make sure that all their watches show the same time.
使（多個鐘錶）顯示同一時間，統一校準（多個鐘錶）

example: The show was designed so that the lights synchronized with the music.
根據設計，演出時的燈光和音樂是同步搭配的。
We'd better synchronize our watches if we all want to be there at the same time.
如果我們大家想同時到達那裡，最好先對時。

NONE: › a sport in which a group of people make smooth, attractive movements like dancing in the water at the same time
水上芭蕾
› formal happening or done at the same time or speed
同時的

example: The dancers perform a sequence of wonderfully synchronous movements.
舞者們的一段表演整齊劃一，十分奇妙。

NONE: › a downward, U-shaped fold in the layers of rock in the earth's surface
（岩石的）向斜層

anticline

（曲調）切分的
› a short period of time when a person becomes unconscious
暈厥

example: Postural syncope occurs when the body cannot supply enough blood to the brain in the upright position because of low blood pressure.
直立時因血壓過低導致大腦供血不足時會出現直立性暈厥。

NONE: › a joint where two bones are held together by ligaments (= strong strips of tissue)
韌帶聯合關節

example: Some ankle fractures have an associated injury to the syndesmosis.

NONE: › (of articles and photographs) sold to several different newspapers and magazines for publishing
（稿件和照片）賣給多家報刊雜誌發表的，一稿多投的
› mainly US (of television or radio programmes) sold to several different broadcasting organizations
（電視或廣播節目）賣給多間播出單位的

C: › [ C ] a combination of medical problems that shows the existence of a particular disease or mental condition
併發症，症候群，綜合症狀
› [ C ] a type of negative behaviour or mental state that is typical of a person in a particular situation

example: See also

irritable bowel syndrome

這是百無聊賴的家庭主婦的典型特徵——整天除了喝酒、購物，就沒有甚麼事情可做了。

NONE: › a word or phrase in which a part of something is used to refer to the whole of it, for example "a pair of hands" for "a worker", or the whole of something is used to refer to a part, for example "the law" for "a police officer"

› the combined power of a group of things when they are working together that is greater than the total power achieved by each working separately

宗教會議
C2 a word or phrase that has the same or nearly the same meaning as another word or phrase in the same language

small 和 little 是同義詞。
Compare
antonym

NONE: C2 having the same meaning
同義的，近義的
C2 If you say that one thing is synonymous with another, you mean that the two things are so closely connected in most people's minds that one suggests the other.
等同的

example: The words "annoyed" and "irritated" are more or less synonymous.
annoyed 和 irritated 兩個詞幾乎是同義的。

奧斯卡‧王爾德的名字成了機智幽默的同義詞。

NONE: › a short description of the contents of something such as a film or book

NONE: › to produce a substance by a chemical reaction in plants or animals
合成

example: There are many vitamins that the body cannot synthesize itself.
有很多維他命是人體無法自己合成的。

NONE: › an electronic keyboard instrument that can produce and combine a large range of recorded sounds, often in order to copy other musical instruments or voices
電子音響合成器，電聲合成器
